delivery_process.fast_lint: Every art PR: source-lock, single authority, illegal overlays, file size delta, placeholders; parallel 10-category independent producer
delivery_process.art_candidate: Each substantially changed world or combat pack: 8 fixed-camera comparison scenes plus 4 short action clips for presentation; only relevant clips per incremental PR, full suite at RC batch
delivery_process.visual_review: Expert/Human side-by-side against actual validated reference frames, 1-5 per dimension with .5 granularity, notes and severity; no AI-only PASS
delivery_process.rc_gate: Sole #220 authenticated writer, latest HEAD nonforce CAS, exact Rojo and source, same-head artifact receipts; Studio before/after PC Android and Owner at publication gate
delivery_process.speed: Do not pause source development awaiting owner review for each small asset; verify safety at each PR, batch real visual reviews at RC milestones. P0 defects always take priority.
